T2_hero.lead: A Bio-Rad system for ID-Card testing, continuous loading, and automation of blood grouping, antibody screening, and titration.

T3_about.h2: What IH-500 NEXT is and who it is for
T3_about.text: IH-500 NEXT is a fully automated Bio-Rad system for immunohematology testing with ID-Cards. It is intended for laboratories that need continuous loading and automated blood grouping, antibody screening, and titration. Individual tests and STAT samples can be processed without waiting for the entire batch to finish.

items.text: Samples and reagents can be loaded continuously, while ID-Cards are processed well by well. This allows laboratories to run individual tests and prioritize STAT samples.
Active cooling supports onboard reagent stability for up to seven days, while two-fold dilutions for antibody titration are automated, according to the manufacturer.

items.q: What tests is IH-500 NEXT designed for?
items.a: It automates immunohematology testing with ID-Cards, including blood grouping, antibody screening, and titration.

items.q: What is the capacity of IH-500 NEXT?
items.a: The system has 50 sample positions, capacity for 164 ID-Cards, and 34 reagent positions.

items.q: Can STAT samples be added during operation?
items.a: Yes. Continuous loading and well-by-well ID-Card processing allow STAT samples to be prioritized.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains IH-500 NEXT in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.
